rules: Keep the example-data banner visible and use the supplied disclosure caption for browser previews.
Do not describe example numbers as measured storage, cleanup savings, performance, or native test results.
Do not use legacy or unverified-current previews to represent the current release.
Review rights, privacy, currentness and target-page context independently before publication.
Current browser captures can illustrate the current-source UI with explicit example-data captions; never represent them as native measurements.
reusePolicy.rightsNotes: First-party repository assets. App package declares Apache-2.0; publication-specific image and third-party app-icon clearance was not independently established. No blanket image licence is inferred.
